$comment: Every website image slot. The renderer uses a slot's own files only when status is 'implemented'; otherwise it shows the named fallback from 'library', or a neutral placeholder where the layout requires one. Process supplied images with: npm run images:process -- <slot> <file>. Prompts and validation criteria: docs/IMAGE-PRODUCTION-QUEUE.md.

statuses.awaiting-user-image: Prompt delivered; waiting for the owner's ChatGPT Images output
statuses.ready-for-review: Processed into AVIF/WebP; needs visual approval before use
statuses.implemented: Approved and rendered on the site
statuses.interim: Rendered now from existing approved artwork; replace when final asset exists
statuses.blocked: Cannot be produced honestly until a product fact is confirmed
